statement: Lead times for high-capacitance, high-specification MLCCs used in AI servers are stretching toward 40 weeks on AI server demand.
why: Passive components are cheap but gating: a 40-week wait on a specification-specific capacitor can hold up whole AI server builds regardless of accelerator availability.

impact.mechanism: Extending long-lead passive component supply constrains AI server assembly throughput, delaying deployment of accelerators and the racks, power and fabric around them.

evidence.excerpt: AI server demand pushes high-end MLCC lead times toward 40 weeks.

Multilayer ceramic capacitor (MLCC) supply is increasingly diverging by product specification, with mainstream components remaining relatively stable while lead times for some high-capacitance, high-specification parts used in AI servers stretch toward 40...

confidence.basis: Single secondary trade outlet, paywalled beyond the lede; the 40-week figure comes from the headline with the body figure cut off and no named suppliers or per-supplier detail visible.

dispersion: Document notes supply is diverging by specification: mainstream MLCC remains relatively stable while only high-capacitance, high-specification parts stretch out.
entity: MLCC suppliers / AI server supply chain
